name: Lightning Storm CI-CD

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Python Test
        run:
          python main.py


  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Main
        run:
          bash main.sh
